chunks: And in it it is narrated that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He granted him authority over the disbelievers.
ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this distinction to clarify that Satan's dominion is conditional upon human acceptance of his call, rather than an inherent power over all creation. This aligns with the Shia theological view that true believers (*mu'minun*) are protected from his absolute sway through their conscious adherence to divine guidance, distinguishing them from those who actively follow his path.
